en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a waterfront quay lined with masted sailing ships. In the foreground and middle distance there is a long column of soldiers on horseback moving along the cobbled street beside the harbor. On the right, civilian pedestrians walk along the sidewalk and telephone poles line the road. At the top right is printed text reading "SALONIQUE – Le Quai." A web address "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.
